I'm afraid i can't quite recommend this game. I know it's really popular for f2p players, and the game is incredibly polished, but i still can't recommend it. Let me begin with the good. 

The game has very crisp graphics, smooth gameplay, and is very dynamic. It promotes teamplay and has numerous objectives and an interesting world built up. As the player progresses through a solar system (each planet has a couple missions), they'll unlock other planets and the system will finish off with a boss. This is fine, and coupled with the solid gameplay, it makes for a fine time. This game also has a pretty solid amount of customization options, where you can upgrade your suit similar to that in crysis 3. The suits also have different powers and focus on different roles, such as tanking or being a caster, in a sense. 

Unfortunately, the game is incredibly grindy, to the point that its borderline punishing for f2p players. You can keep progressing through the game if you just started, but the enemies ramp up with artificial difficulty. What i mean by that, is that instead of fighting against new, unique enemies that have different attack patterns, you just fight enemies that have much much larger shields and hit harder. It seems rather unimaginitive. Of course, you may be wondering, "why don't you just get better gear DistraughtPompano". Well let me tell you, in the 16 hours that i put into this game, i think i only maybe 2 weapons past the two weapons you start with. I may have unlocked a single warframe past the starting one too, but i highly doubt that as i played the game a long time ago. It takes a painfully large amount of time to unlock weapons, requiring you to purchase a blueprint, which wasn't particularly cheap, and then to repetitively grind out the same missions over and over just to farm a crafting material. Just to top it off, once you had that all said and done, you would still need to wait 24 hours (varies on the weapon) just for the weapon to be completed in crafting stage. You can bypass this by paying money, of course. The weapons i did get, hardly felt like an upgrade though. And being forced to grind out the same missions over and over made me painfully conscious of the gameplay, which no longer felt refreshing, but felt like a big chore. Because of that, i dont think i could recommend this game to any of my friends because it just requires too much investment for too little payout, unless you are willing to put money into the game. And i don't hate the devs or anything; i think it's perfectly fine for people to put money into this game as its fine polish and attention to detail should go rewarded.

I have a good amount of hours on this game and i can tell you this is the BEST free to play game EVER they have so much stuff to do that you never run out and they update the game like 6 times a year so you always have stuff to do BEST GAME EVER!

EDIT: It has been 4ish years since i posted this review on Warframe. To be completely honest i have disliked the direction the game has gone. What used to be my favorite part of the game, the void, was completely changed and it makes me upset to this day. Another thing that has bothered me is that the game has gone even farther into P2W then it used to be. Yes you can get everything in the game for free, besides some of the prime access stuff, through the platinum system and the trade chat, but you can also buy pretty much everything with real money to boost yourself through the game much faster. But to be fair others being P2W doesnt affect you very much. 

Many people may think that the openworld part of the game is cool, but when it wasnt around the game felt way better to play. I feel forced to play the openworld content because of the new items and the necessary equipment it gives, but i hate the openworld a lot. What i enjoyed was sitting in a void survival for hours and not feeling forced to do content i didnt like. The MMO style they went for was not what i was personally looking for. I wasnt there to mine ores and fly around on a speeder. I wanted to sit in Draco with a Radial Javelin build and a Ash who wiped the entire map with his 4th ability, and gain tons of exp so that i could forma my warframe or weapons 5 times in one day. I liked the grind the game had before, i think many people did. I feel as though the old type of grind has changed and we have less need and to sit in a survival for hours unless were after polymer bundles.

I dont like how DE decided to expand the game instead of just adding onto the existing things. Yes it is a game company and they want to keep up to date with their content, but they did too much too fast. The entire world system that they had in the game was plenty, all they needed to do was expand it. If they added more planets like the derelict it would have been so much fun. There is a reason the community lost a bunch of veteran players, they changed the feel of the game. On the bright side the game is doing very well for itself and it has brought in tons of new players. During one of the dev streams they did say that they were looking to try and grab new players, and they did so at the expense of a lot of veterans.

TBH the game is still decent and there is a boat load of content to explore. I would say it is up there in the top free to play games, but it doesnt interest me as much as it used to. I still recommend the game, but not as much as i used to.
